RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Endless prism
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: critical value +100%; direct damage +60%. Critical value above 100% continues to increase critical damage.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Bloodforged armor
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: direct-hit lifesteal +35%; body health +120%; damage-taken divisor +0.5.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Blacksteel talons
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: steel growth level +1.5; body health +80%; damage-taken divisor +0.5. Eligible direct hits gain steel marks at most once every 2 seconds. Each permanent growth effect retains its full benefit through 100 points, then has diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Timeblade
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: rage level +2; melee cooldown divisor +1.2; ranged cooldown divisor +1.2. The first 20 temporary stacks retain their full effect; further stacks have diminishing returns.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Trinity singularity
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: direct damage +80%; critical value +35%; cleave level +1; chain level +1; move speed +40%; global work speed +40%. Copied damage uses its resolved value; flat bonus damage can still be amplified.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Immortal charm
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: damage-taken divisor +0.6; ordinary injury healed per second +2.5; move speed +35%. Blocks one hit and heals 35 ordinary injury points, at most once every 30 seconds.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Fleet-footed
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 35% movement speed per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Jeweled Gauntlet
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack grants 25% critical value and allows ability damage to critically strike. Critical value above 100% increases critical damage. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Immovable
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 30% health per stack. Damage taken is divided by (1 + 0.35 × stacks). Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Second wind
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Heals 1.2 points of ordinary injuries per second per stack, applied about every 4.2 seconds. Does not repair permanent scars or missing body parts. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Blood feast
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Heals ordinary injuries for 25% of direct damage dealt to enemies per stack. Stacks with Blood pact and Bloodforged armor. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: One-person army
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 90% damage against enemies, 70% health and 20% lifesteal per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Fortune's favor
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Each stack adds 60% critical value and 40% direct damage. Critical value above 100% increases critical damage.

RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.label: Path to ascension
RimHex.HexEnemySourceDef037.description: Adds 75% damage against enemies and 75% health, and heals 1.8 points of ordinary injuries per second per stack. Draft limit: 6 stacks.
